counterfactual_missing_items: histopathologic confirmation of hepatoblastoma from the biopsy
explicit distinction between tumor thrombus and bland thrombus
decisive_items: a 17 × 9 cm mixed solid and cystic mass occupying the right hepatic lobe
an infrarenal IVC thrombus and a near-occlusive embolus in the left pulmonary artery
response.rationale: The large right hepatic lobe mass in a child is the root diagnosis (hepatoblastoma); the IVC thrombus and pulmonary artery embolus are downstream complications. R1 uniquely explains the entire sequence, whereas R4/R3/R5 name only embolic/thrombotic findings and R2 names an unconfirmed concern.

rejected.why: Only a clinical concern; no guarding/rebound and the drain/biopsy were for the mass; does not explain the liver mass or embolic findings.
Pulmonary embolism is a complication of the underlying process, not the primary diagnosis; ignores the hepatic mass and IVC thrombus.
IVC thrombosis is a local finding/complication, not the underlying disease; does not account for the large liver mass or pulmonary embolus.
